Scott Eldridge, CEO, stated: "We are very pleased with the strong investor response to this financing, particularly given the challenging market conditions facing the junior resource sector. The upsizing of the original amount demonstrates continued investor confidence in Military Metals and speaks to the quality of our asset portfolio including our flagship Trojarova project in Europe, the continents premier antimony asset. Securing this additional capital in the current market environment is a positive endorsement of our team and strategy as we continue to advance our projects."
In connection with the Offering, the Company paid a finder's fee of $2,400 in cash to an eligible finder.

The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the Offering for further exploration activities related to the Trojarova Gold-Antimony Project in Slovakia, technical studies related to the same, and general working capital. All securities issued in connection with the Offering are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day following the Closing Date in accordance with applicable Canadian securities laws and policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange.
